def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

import itertools
cells=[(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if inp[r][c]==8]
def g(rr,cc): return inp[rr][cc] if 0<=rr<7 and 0<=cc<7 else 0
def z(rr,cc): return 1 if 0<=rr<7 and 0<=cc<7 and inp[rr][cc]==0 else 0
feats={}
for r,c in cells:
    o=out[r][c]
    f={
      'cnt3':sum(g(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1)),
      'cnt5':sum(g(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-2,-1,0,1,2) for dc in(-2,-1,0,1,2)),
      'z3':9-sum(g(r+dr,c+dc) for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1))//8,
      'orth':sum(g(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))),
      'diag':sum(g(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in((-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1))),
      'zU':z(r-1,c)+z(r-2,c)+z(r-1,c-1)+z(r-1,c+1),
      'zD':z(r+1,c)+z(r+2,c)+z(r+1,c-1)+z(r+1,c+1),
      'zL':z(r,c-1)+z(r,c-2)+z(r-1,c-1)+z(r+1,c-1),
      'zR':z(r,c+1)+z(r,c+2)+z(r-1,c+1)+z(r+1,c+1),
      'vlen':1,'hlen':1,
    }
    # run lengths
    a=c
    while g(r,a-1)==8: a-=1
    b=c
    while g(r,b+1)==8: b+=1
    f['hlen']=b-a+1
    a=r
    while g(a-1,c)==8: a-=1
    b=r
    while g(b+1,c)==8: b+=1
    f['vlen']=b-a+1
    feats[(r,c)]=(o,f)
for name in ['cnt3','cnt5','orth','diag','hlen','vlen','zU','zD','zL','zR']:
    m={}
    ok=True
    for k,(o,f) in feats.items():
        m.setdefault(f[name],set()).add(o)
    bad=[(v,cs) for v,cs in m.items() if len(cs)>1]
    print(name, 'clean' if not bad else f'conflicts: {bad}')

    obj={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==8}
    claim={}
    def win(r,c): return [(r,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c),(r+1,c+1)]

        # row-major first unclaimed

        for (wr,wc,pos) in [(r,c,'TL'),(r,c-1,'TR'),(r-1,c,'BL'),(r-1,c-1,'BR')]:

            w=win(wr,wc)
            unc=[q for q in w if q in obj and q not in claim]
